gb.title: Heat network sector confident but underprepared for HNTAS, new industry research warns
gb.description: New research among industry stakeholders reveals a GB-wide gap between confidence and capability ahead of the forthcoming Heat Network Technical Assurance Scheme (HNTAS) within the wider new regulatory framework. The research, commissioned by Guru Systems, the market-leading provider of heat network hardware, software and analytics, found that 90% of respondents believe their networks will meet the draft HNTAS metering and monitoring requirements without major changes. Yet the findings suggest that this confidence may be overstated. Despite high self-reported confidence, no key draft HNTAS requirement was identified by more than 27% of respondents. Such is the knowledge gap that nearly one in five respondents mistakenly believe HNTAS will be largely voluntary. 12% believe it will only apply to networks receiving public funding. More than 75% did not identify that the draft technical specifications require high-frequency automated data collection. The same number are unaware that they will need to comply with data protection and cybersecurity requirements for metering data. Only a quarter of respondents identified the expected need for a formal metering and monitoring strategy. These gaps indicate a sector that is not yet aligned on what the draft HNTAS rules demand. Operational readiness is similarly limited. Only a quarter of organisations proactively manage their heat networks and just 26% have full instrumentation across their portfolio, despite both being key to compliance as defined in the draft HNTAS documents. Plus, there is equally low awareness of who is responsible for compliance. This lack of readiness suggests many operators may face significant challenges once HNTAS is implemented. Casey Cole, CEO of Guru Systems, comments: “Our research shows a considerable gap between confidence and practical readiness. Without action, this disconnect could create operational, financial and compliance risks for the sector.” The research, from the Guru Systems ‘HNTAS: The Confidence Paradox Report’ also highlights a big difference across the regions. London recorded the highest rate of proactive heat network management, at 45%, five times higher than Wales or Yorkshire and the Humber (9%). Only 9% in Wales recognise the need for high-frequency automated data collection. Just 4% have fully instrumented networks with automated data collection. Scotland had the highest proportion of respondents that believe HNTAS will be voluntary. These disparities risk creating uneven compliance and inconsistent network performance across regions. Casey Cole continues: “Heat networks need to perform well across every region of the country to effectively contribute to energy security and affordability. The Government must communicate the proposed requirements of the new regulations more consistently and heat network operators must engage with the changes, build the necessary capability and put the systems in place to succeed.” Download the full Report now. gr.title: Πανεκπαιδευτικό συλλαλητήριο: Φοιτητές και μαθητές διαδηλώνουν μαζικά στις 5/11 για τα προβλήματα της Παιδείας
gr.description: Μαθητές και φοιτητές μπαίνουν ξανά στο χορό των κινητοποιήσεων με πανεκπαιδευτικό συλλαλητήριο στο Σύνταγμα την Πέμπτη 5 Νοεμβρίου, τα αιτήματά τους. Νέο πανεκπαιδευτικό συλλαλητήριο για την Πέμπτη 5 Νοεμβρίου προγραμματίζουν μαθητές και φοιτητές με επίκεντρο τη δημόσια και δωρεάν Παιδεία. Ακολουθώντας το παράδειγμα της νεολαίας στη Γαλλία που διεκδικεί καλύτερες συνθήκες σπουδών σε όλες τις βαθμίδες, μαθητές και φοιτητές ενώνουν τις δυνάμεις τους και απευθύνουν κάλεσμα μαζικής συμμετοχής στις διαδηλώσεις στα Προπύλαια και τις μεγάλες πόλεις της επικράτειας. Το ραντεβού είναι προγραμματισμένο για συγκέντρωση στις 11:00 στα Προπύλαια,για συγκέντρωση στις 11:00 στα Προπύλαια, με σύνθημα «Ξανά κλειστά πανεπιστήμια και κλειστά σχολεία και όλοι στον δρόμο! Από την Ελλάδα μέχρι τη Γαλλία παλεύουμε για δημόσια και δωρεάν Παιδεία!». Η μαθητιώσα και η φοιτητιώσα νεολαία παίρνει τη σκυτάλη των διαδηλώσεων από την Γαλλία και καλεί σε πανελλαδική πανεκπαιδευτική συμμετοχή διεκδικώντας δημόσια και δωρεάν Παιδεία και στέλνοντας μήνυμα υπέρ της πρόσβασης όλων στην εκπαίδευση. Το κάλεσμα των μαθητών: «Σε Ελλάδα και Γαλλία ίδια προβλήματα, παντού ξεσηκωμός» Οι μαθητές της Δευτεροβάθμιας ξεσηκώνονται και η Συντονιστική Επιτροπή Μαθητών της Αθήνας δείχνει το δρόμο των κινητοποιήσεων. «Κλείνουμε τα σχολεία την Πέμπτη 4η Νοέμβρη και βουλιάζουμε ξανά τους δρόμους για τα δικαιώματά μας. Δεν ανεχόμαστε να μας λένε ότι δεν έχουν λεφτά για την Παιδεία ενώ δίνουν δις. ευρώ σε πολέμους, σε εξοπλισμούς για τα σφαγεία του ΝΑΤΟ, δε συμβιβαζόμαστε να μην βγάζουν οι οικογένειές μας τον μήνα, να μην μπορούμε να πάμε ούτε μέχρι το κυλικείο από την ακρίβεια ενώ επιχειρηματίες, σουπερμαρκετάδες, εφοπλιστές, βιομήχανοι πολλαπλασιάζουν τα κέρδη τους, δεν αντέχουμε άλλο το σχολείο εξοντωτικό, εξεταστικό κέντρο που σχεδιάζουν να το κάνουν ακόμη χειρότερο με το Εθνικό Απολυτήριο και τις Τριπλές Πανελλήνιες. Τα αιτήματά μας περιμένουν απάντηση και θα αγωνιζόμαστε μέχρι να κατακτήσουμε όσα ζητάμε!». Μεταξύ άλλων οι μαθητές διεκδικούν χρηματοδότηση και άμεσο σχέδιο ελέγχων και αποκατάστασης των σχολικών κτηρίων, κάλυψη όλων των κενών στα σχολεία αλλά και να αποσυρθεί η επίμαχη υπουργική απόφαση για τις σχολικές εκδρομές. Τέλος ζητάνε δωρεάν σνακ στους μαθητές και μείωση των τιμών στα σχολικά κυλικεία με κατάργηση του ΦΠΑ στα είδη διατροφής. Μαθητικό συλλαλητήριο και «κλειστά σχολεία» στις 5/11: Τι ισχύει για μαθήματα και απουσίες Οι μαθητητές στην ανακοίνωσή για το συλλαλητήριο κάνουν λόγο για «κλειστά σχολεία» την Πέμπτη 5 Νοεμβρίου. Όμως όπως τονίζουν πηγές του Υπουργείου Παιδείας στο Dnews σε καμία περίπτωση δεν προβλέπεται οριζόντιο λουκέτο και αναστολή μαθημάτων σε Γυμνάσια και Λύκεια ενώ θα τηρηθεί και παρουσιολόγιο. Η πρόθεση των μαθητών δεν ισοδυναμεί και με λουκέτο στις σχολικές τους μονάδες. Τα 15μελη των σχολείων κατόπιν συνεδρίασης θα αποφασίσουν για το αν θα συμμετάσχουν ή όχι στην διαμαρτυρία αλλά τα μαθήματα θα διεξαχθούν κανονικά στα σχολεία ανεξαρτήτως απόφασης του 15μελους. Ο μοναδικός λόγος για να μην γίνουν μαθήματα στα σχολεία εκείνη την ημέρα είναι να προχωρήσουν οι μαθητές σε κατάληψη. Φοιτητές: «Δώστε λεφτά για την Παιδεία» Aπό πλευράς τους οι φοιτητές διεκδικούν ουσιαστική αναβάθμιση των σπουδών. Μιλώντας στο Dnews εκπρόσωπος των φοιτητών δήλωσε ότι «Αρνούμαστε την ίδρυση ιδιωτικών πανεπιστημίων και την αναθεώρηση του άρθρου 16 του Συντάγματος. Ζητάμε αύξηση της ετήσιας κρατικής χρηματοδότησης και έκτακτο κονδύλι σε όλα τα Πανεπιστήμια για να καλυφθούν τα λειτουργικά έξοδα, η θέρμανση, να ενισχυθεί η φοιτητική μέριμνα. Διεκδικούμε σύγχρονες και ασφαλείς υποδομές. Πτυχία με αξία, μοναδική προϋπόθεση για μόνιμη και σταθερή δουλειά με δικαιώματα. Σύγχρονα προγράμματα σπουδών που ενσωματώνουν τις εξελίξεις στην επιστήμη και την τεχνολογία. Λέμε ένα μεγάλο ηχηρό «όχι» στις διαγραφές φοιτητών. Απαιτούμε κατάργηση του νομοθετικού πλαισίου έντασης της καταστολής στα ΑΕΙ. Παλεύουμε για να μπει πλαφόν στα ενοίκια αλλά και για να αυξηθεί το φοιτητικό στεγαστικό επίδομα και να διευρυνθούν οι δικαιούχοι με κατάργηση των ακαδημαϊκών κριτηρίων και αύξηση των οικονομικών ορίων.» #ΠΑΝΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΤΙΚΟ_ΣΥΛΛΑΛΗΤΗΡΙΟ #ΜΑΘΗΤΕΣ #ΦΟΙΤΗΤΕΣ #ΠΑΙΔΕΙΑ #ΜΑΘΗΤΙΚΟ_ΣΥΛΛΑΛΗΤΗΡΙΟ #ΦΟΙΤΗΤΙΚΟ_ΣΥΛΛΑΛΗΤΗΡΙΟ

mx.title: SEP inicia restricción al uso de celulares en aulas del país
mx.description: A partir del 3 de noviembre de 2026, la Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP) comenzará a aplicar la restricción al uso de teléfonos celulares y otros dispositivos personales en los planteles de educación básica, media superior y superior del país. Las reglas permiten su uso solo con fines educativos y en casos excepcionales. Las disposiciones se difundieron desde septiembre de 2026 en el Diario Oficial de la Federación (DOF). En educación básica, el uso de dispositivos se autorizará ante emergencias personales, por motivos de discapacidad, accesibilidad, inclusión y necesidad de salud, así como para atender necesidades particulares y extraordinarias. Fuera de esos supuestos, los alumnos deberán dejar los aparatos en casa o mantenerlos guardados durante toda la jornada escolar, incluido el recreo. Para los docentes, el acuerdo establece que deberán ser ejemplo en el uso seguro y responsable de los dispositivos. En educación media superior, la SEP fijó en un decálogo que se limitará el uso no pedagógico de los aparatos durante la jornada y que cada plantel definirá la forma de hacerlo mediante consultas y acuerdos con su comunidad educativa. Entre las opciones previstas están mantener los equipos guardados; retirarlos y depositarlos en un espacio bajo custodia de las autoridades escolares; permitir su uso solo en determinados horarios y espacios; impedirlo durante toda la jornada, o fijar días específicos para emplearlos como herramientas de aprendizaje. En educación superior, la dependencia federal señaló que se fomentará el uso responsable y seguro de los dispositivos durante toda la jornada, conforme a los acuerdos de cada comunidad educativa y a las disposiciones de las autoridades e instituciones correspondientes. En los días previos al arranque de la medida, las escuelas realizaron asambleas con madres y padres de familia, tutores y otros integrantes de las comunidades educativas para informar sobre las disposiciones y construir acuerdos.

co.title: Usuarios de paraderos de rutas de buses en el Valle de Aburrá padecen su mal estado: ¿quién responde?
co.description: Cada que a los urbanistas se les pregunta qué se puede hacer para mejorar la movilidad en la ciudad, la respuesta automática y habitual es mantener e incentivar el uso del transporte público por parte de los habitantes de la ciudad, sobre todo, en lo que comprende al Metro y sus rutas integradas. ¿Pero, cómo esperan siquiera que la gente use este sistema cuando todos los días deben sufrir afugias en temas tan básicos y elementales como son los paraderos de buses de estas? En redes sociales, y en las filas, son muchas las quejas sobre el estado actual de varios paraderos asociados a las rutas integradas del Metro pues en algunas zonas de la ciudad, estos –aparte de insuficientes– están dañados o destruidos. Resulta que no más en Medellín hay 833 paraderos de las rutas integradas de Metro por las que llegan buena parte del casi millón de usuarios que los trenes mueven a diario. En los otros municipios también hay paraderos sobre todo cerca a las estaciones de la Línea A. Sin embargo, algunos de los paraderos más dañados se ubican justo donde más se necesitan, es decir donde no hay viaducto. Por ejemplo, la Estación Estrella que mueve unos 24.700 usuarios cada día tiene por el lado de la avenida Regional un paradero, este por lo menos está en buen estado. Pero en el otro extremo, en la salida hacia la zona de bodegas de la autopista Sur, allí apenas hay unos cuatro paraderos con cerca de 30 metros cubiertos con plásticos en muy mal estado que aparte de estar torcidos como una “arepa tiesa”, resultan insuficientes para la altísima demanda de usuarios. “Esos paraderos llevan como cinco meses malos. Vienen, los arreglan y a los días vuelven y se dañan. Como que pegan mal esas láminas. Cuando llueve a la gente le toca taparse con las sombrillas de las chazas, o mojarse en las filas que, incluso, pueden ‘largarse’ como una cancha de fúbtol (unos 200 metros). Yo no entiendo por qué no los hacen largos como en Niquía si acá llegan tantas personas”, apuntó una vendedora de la zona. Esta misma dinámica se repite en los paraderos de la estación Sabaneta a donde llegan diariamente 16.000 usuarios. Mientras que el lado de Sabaneta apenas tiene un paradero, que al menos sirve. Los dos que hay en el lado de Itagüí dan vergüenza, pues apenas les quedan los parales y la banca metálica. Otro de los trabajadores de la zona comentó que los paraderos allí pueden llevar malos casi ocho años. Sí, años, sin que los intervengan. “Eso duró bueno como dos años no más, porque como no los hicieron altos, los buses reversando tumban los techos. O también los pegaban mal. Una vez, en un aguacero, una lámina casi le cae a una señora encima”, detalló el hombre a la vez que contemplaba a una mujer maquillada en exceso sentada en la banca del “paradero” bajo un sol canicular. En el lado de Itagüí, estación que mueve unos 25.400 pasajeros al día, del lado de Sabaneta pasa un asunto peculiar. Resulta que de los tres paraderos que hay, el de la Autopista fue “clausurado”, por lo que a los usuarios les toca hacer maromas para bajarse de los buses. Mientras que en Envigado, Ayurá y Aguacatala el problema ya no es el estado de los paraderos sino su insuficiencia, toda vez que estas parada mueven 27.200, 18.000, 25.400 y 41.300 usuarios respectivamente al día. Allí, lo habitual es encontrar entre uno y dos por cada salida de las estaciones. Mención especial merece la estación Poblado pues, pese a ser una de las más concurridas del sistema con casi 50.000 personas por día, en el lado de la avenida Regional no tiene ni un solo paradero de integrados. En Industriales, otra de las estaciones que recibe gran afluencia de pasajeros, se repite el mismo drama pues los paraderos no reciben atención hace cuatro meses. Allí, los usuarios de dos rutas integradas debe vivir el calvario de no tener donde refugiarse del sol o de la lluvia ya que la parada tiene las tejas quebradas. “Acá cuando llueve, toca arrumarse debajo de la sombrilla de las ‘chazas’. Parecemos cigarrillos”, comentó una usuaria. “Le va a tocar comprar una carpa pa’ que quepa más gente”, bromeó una de las vendedoras a uno de sus colegas. EL COLOMBIANO consultó con el Metro de Medellín para conocer su postura ante la situación. La entidad señaló que apenas tiene en comodato 31 paraderos ubicados en el área de influencia de algunas de sus estaciones en Medellín. Detalló que los demás paraderos así como su mantenimiento y construcción son potestad de cada alcaldía. Por su parte, La Alcaldía de Medellín dijo que de los 802 paraderos a su cargo, 793 están en funcionamiento. Los nueve paraderos restantes presentan afectaciones mayores, asociadas principalmente a actos de vandalismo o choques. Indicaron que sobre estos puntos se realiza seguimiento semanal para priorizar su recuperación, hecho que contrastaría con lo comentado por los usuarios. “Desde la Secretaría de Infraestructura Física continuamos haciendo seguimiento a los paraderos para contribuir a que los usuarios del transporte público cuenten con espacios adecuados, limpios y seguros”, dijo la entidad. De otro lado, el municipio de Itagüí se comprometió a reparar los paraderos afectados en la estación Sabaneta, dijeron que en 20 días iniciarán su reparación. Eso sí, aclaró que no habrá nuevos paraderos para esta zona. Por lo tanto, la Alcaldía de La Estrella aseguró que pese a que la estación se asocia al municipio, el mantenimiento de los paraderos de esta no le corresponden al municipio sino a su vecino, Sabaneta, por temas de jurisdicción. bd.title: Laboratoires Pierre Fabre announces the approval of BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib) in combination with MEKTOVI® (binimetinib) for the treatment of adult patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer with a BRAFV600E mutation in Singapore
bd.description: New targeted treatment option now available in for adult patients with BRAFV600E mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) Launch follows European approval based on results from the Phase II PHAROS trial, demonstrating meaningful clinical benefit to patients with a high objective response rate (ORR)1,2 SINGAPORE, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Laboratoires Pierre Fabre Singapore is delighted to announce the access for patients to BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib) in combination with MEKTOVI® (binimetinib) for the treatment of adult patients with advanced NSCLC with a BRAFV600E mutation. It follows the European Commission (EC) approval that was based on the results from the Phase II PHAROS trial, a global, open-label, multicentre, non-randomised trial to determine the efficacy and safety of BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® in 98 patients from 56 study centres across 5 countries.1,2 Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths, with 1,278 deaths in Singapore annually, and 1,942 new cases diagnosed every year whereby 1-2% of NSCLC are BRAFV600E mutant.3,4 "We are delighted to be able to bring BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® to NSCLC patients with a BRAFV600E mutation in Singapore. This approval from Health Sciences Authority (HSA) is a significant milestone as BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® will give patients the option of an additional effective targeted therapy. This is a further demonstration of our commitment to addressing the most critical needs in cancer care today through the delivery of clinically meaningful treatments," said Jairo Pardey, General Manager Laboratoires Pierre Fabre, Singapore. About the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) approval The BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® Singapore approved prescribing information includes results from the Phase II PHAROS trial.1,5,6 At primary analysis (cut-off date: September 22, 2022), the primary endpoint of the trial (objective response rate [ORR] determined by independent radiology review [IRR]) was met. In the treatment-naïve population (n=59), the ORR was 75% (95% CI: 62, 85), including 15% complete responses (CRs) and 59% partial responses (PRs).1,5,6 Updated results with an additional 10-month follow-up showed that 64% of patients maintained a response for at least 12 months, with a median duration of response (mDOR) per IRR of 40 months (95% CI: 23.1, not estimable [NE]). 5,6* For those patients who had received prior therapy (n=39), the ORR by IRR was 46% (95% CI: 30, 63), including 10% CRs and 36% PRs at primary analysis.1,5,6 Updated results with an additional 10-month follow-up showed that 44% of patients maintained a response for at least 12 months with a mDOR of 16.7 months (95% CI: 7.4, NE).5,6* The most common treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs ≥20%) were nausea (50%), diarrhoea (43%), fatigue (32%), and vomiting (29%). Treatment-related serious AEs occurred in 14% of patients, with the most common being colitis (3%).1,6 One grade 5 TRAE of intracranial haemorrhage was reported.1 *Results for mDOR from a sensitivity analysis considering new anti-cancer therapy as an event in addition to progression and death are 23.1 months in treatment-naïve patients (14.8, NE) and 12.0 months (6.3, NE) in previously treated patients.5 About PHAROS PHAROS (NCT03915951) is an on-going open-label, single arm, multicentre, non-randomised Phase II trial to determine the efficacy and safety of BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib 450 mg QD) in combination with MEKTOVI® (binimetinib 45 mg BID) in 98 patients with advanced NSCLC with a BRAFV600E mutation who are either treatment-naive or who have been previously treated with platinum-based chemotherapy and/or anti-PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor therapy. Mutations were identified using next-generation sequencing or polymerase chain reaction tests. The primary endpoint is confirmed ORR per RECIST v1.1, by independent radiology review (IRR); secondary objectives comprise additional efficacy endpoints including duration of response (DOR), progression-free survival, and overall survival as well as safety. The trial is being conducted across 56 sites in: Italy, the Netherlands, South Korea, Spain, and the U.S. The PHAROS trial is sponsored by Pfizer Inc. and conducted with support from Laboratoires Pierre Fabre. About BRAFV600E mutant advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths, with over 1.8 million deaths worldwide annually.7 Globally, lung cancers make up 12.4% of all cancers with over 2.4 million new cases every year.8 Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) accounts for approximately 80-85% of all lung cancers.9.10 Currently, it is estimated that up to 69% of advanced NSCLC patients have druggable mutations in numerous genes.11 BRAFV600E mutations occur in approximately 1-2% of NSCLC cases.4 It stimulates tumour cell growth and proliferation by altering the MAP kinase (MAPK) signalling pathway. Inhibition of both BRAF and the downstream mitogen activated protein kinase (MEK) pathway has been shown to improve response rates in patients compared with BRAF inhibition alone.1,12 Precision medicine has made great progress in the treatment of lung cancer for NSCLC patients with genetic alterations, such as BRAFV600E mutations, that can be detected using biomarker tests.13,14 Advances in targeted therapy and more widespread use of biomarker testing have been associated with significant improvements in population-level NSCLC mortality in recent years.15 About BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib), a potent and highly selective BRAF inhibitor with a distinct pharmacological profile compared with other BRAF inhibitors, and MEKTOVI® (binimetinib), a potent and selective MEK inhibitor, inhibit kinases in the MAPK pathway – which is constitutively activated in BRAFV600E mutant NSCLC - resulting in clinically relevant anti-tumour activity. Uncontrolled activation of this pathway has been shown to occur in many cancers, including melanoma, CRC, and NSCLC.1,16 In 2018, the European Commission (EC) approved BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® for adult patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAFV600 mutation. The approval was based on results from the randomised, active-controlled, open-label, multicentre Phase III COLUMBUS trial. In 2020, the EC approved BRAFTOVI® in combination with cetuximab, for the treatment of adults with metastatic CRC with a BRAFV600E mutation who have received prior systemic therapy. The approval was based on results from the randomised, active-controlled, open-label, multicentre Phase III BEACON CRC trial. Pfizer has exclusive rights to commercialise BRAFTOVI® and MEKTOVI® in the U.S., Canada, and all countries in the Latin American, African, and Middle Eastern regions; Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. has exclusive rights to commercialise both products in Japan and South Korea; Medison has exclusive rights in Israel; and Laboratoires Pierre Fabre has exclusive rights in all other countries, including Europe and Asia-Pacific. The full product and safety information for the use of BRAFTOVI® and MEKTOVI® are outlined in the Product Information (PI) published in the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) database and can be accessed here. About Laboratoires Pierre Fabre Laboratoires Pierre Fabre is one of Europe's leading pharmaceutical laboratories and the world's second-largest dermo-cosmetics company. Its Pharma activity covers 5 main therapeutic fields: oncology, dermatology, rare diseases, primary care and family health care. The Dermo-cosmetics & Personal Care portfolio includes international brands such as Eau Thermale Avène, Dexeryl, Ducray, Klorane, A-Derma, René Furterer, Même Cosmetics, Darrow and Elgydium. For over 40 years, Laboratoires Pierre Fabre has established itself as an international player in oncology, mastering the entire value chain from R&D to marketing. Its portfolio of oncology specialties covers colorectal, breast, lung and skin cancers, as well as certain hematologic malignancies and precancerous dermatological conditions such as actinic keratosis. In 2025, Laboratoires Pierre Fabre' revenues in oncology came to 565 million euros, 71% of which were generated by international sales, out of a total sales figure of 3.2 billion euros. Based in southwest France since its creation, Laboratoires Pierre Fabre manufactures nearly 90% of its products in France and employs 10,000 people worldwide. In 2025, its R&D budget amounted to 250 million euros, of which 67% is allocated to targeted therapies in oncology with 10 research and development programs underway. Laboratoires Pierre Fabre' majority shareholder (86%) is an eponymous humanitarian Foundation. Employees constitute the company's other shareholder. This capital structure guarantees the company's independence, long-term vision and contribution to the common good. The dividends paid to the Pierre Fabre Foundation contribute to 43 healthcare-access programs deployed in 26 of the least developed countries in the world. bd.description: Company presents financial technology platforms and shares experience in adapting solutions for Southeast Asian markets HONG KONG, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Beyondsoft showcased its financial AI and digital solutions at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026, where the company also shared its experience of adapting fintech capabilities developed in China to the needs of Southeast Asian markets. Visitors engage with Beyondsoft at its exhibition booth. The company presented its AI agent platform, mobile application development platform and enterprise digital currency payment collection system. Its team met with financial institutions, technology companies and industry organisations to discuss AI applications, implementation challenges and opportunities for collaboration across the region. AI and Digital Solutions for Financial Services Beyondsoft's AI agent platform combines large language models with industry knowledge bases to support risk management, oversight of funds, automated regulatory reporting and targeted customer engagement. The platform is designed to bring AI into financial workflows and help institutions explore end-to-end automation of core business processes. Built on Beyondsoft's proprietary technology, the mobile application development platform supports financial apps across multiple device environments and enables faster updates, helping teams improve development and delivery efficiency. The enterprise digital currency payment collection system provides payment collection services for financial institutions and corporate clients through a customised software-as-a-service model. Conversations at the exhibition focused on where financial AI agents could be most useful, how to implement them and how to assess their business value. The team also discussed potential partnerships in mobile financial services and digital payments. Adapting China's Fintech Experience to Southeast Asian Markets As part of the event, Ariel Lin, who leads Beyondsoft's Innovation Lab and AI Practice, delivered a presentation on adapting China's financial AI capabilities to Southeast Asian markets. Drawing on China's experience in core banking, AI-powered lending at scale and generative AI in production, Lin emphasised that international expansion requires more than exporting products. Technical expertise, experienced people and proven delivery practices are equally important. Customer expectations, operations and infrastructure vary across Southeast Asia. Technology providers need to adapt their solutions to each market and work with local teams to build the skills needed to maintain and develop them. Technology transfer and knowledge sharing can help local businesses build these capabilities over time. Addressing Local Regulatory Requirements The presentation also examined differences in regulatory requirements across Southeast Asia, with examples from Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. Topics included data protection, biometric identity verification, the fairness and explainability of AI-assisted decisions, and financial data sharing. For cross-border projects, these requirements need to be considered from the outset. Data use must comply with applicable purpose limitations and consent requirements. Biometric applications require attention to liveness detection and accuracy, while AI-assisted decisions need to address fairness and explainability. Financial data sharing must also comply with local banking secrecy and credit information requirements. Lin emphasised that compliance needs to be built into solution design and implementation to help financial institutions manage the risks of deploying AI across markets. Experience in Cross-Border Delivery Beyondsoft's work for the overseas branches of a Chinese global bank illustrated the demands of cross-border technology delivery. The projects covered personal and corporate mobile banking, credit card applications, mobile workplace tools and mobile learning platforms. The work required experience in financial systems development, coordination across platforms and complex project delivery. For institutions operating across borders, individual applications also need to work together, support business continuity and meet regional requirements. With its International Headquarters in Singapore, Beyondsoft continues to connect technology expertise from China with business needs in Southeast Asia. Drawing on its financial technology experience and global service network, the company will explore AI applications and service models suited to regional markets, working with industry partners to bring AI into financial business processes. ****** About Beyondsoft Beyondsoft is a global technology services and solutions company helping organisations accelerate digital transformation and turn technology into business value. With more than 30 years of experience and a global talent network of nearly 30,000 professionals, Beyondsoft delivers capabilities spanning AI and data intelligence, cloud and infrastructure, digital platforms, enterprise applications, managed services and localisation capabilities. With its International Headquarters in Singapore, Beyondsoft supports organisations across Southeast Asia and beyond, combining global technology expertise with local market delivery capabilities. Through its ecosystem of technology partners and industry solutions, Beyondsoft works with organisations of all sizes to adopt emerging technologies, improve operational efficiency and drive sustainable growth. www.beyondsoft.com

ae.title: VOLTA malware hands stolen data to Claude, Gemini and Kimi to find out which crypto holders are worth robbing
ae.description: Info-stealing malware usually takes your passwords and leaves a person to go through the loot. VOLTA-AUTODOXER, a new strain for Windows, gives that job to commercial AI models, and they tell the attacker whether you're a target worth pursuing. A new report from Cisco Talos researchers covers the malware, which usually goes by the shorter name VOLTA. It takes sensitive data from machines it infects and sends it to three models: Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini and Moonshot AI's Kimi. Those models judge how much money each victim could be worth. Cryptocurrency holders are one of the groups it was built to find. When one model refuses, it tries the nextThe malware connects to the models through OpenRouter, a service that offers several AI models through a single connection. Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 is its first pick. The code has a fixed backup order. If Claude fails to process a request, VOLTA tries Moonshot AI's Kimi K2, then Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash. Cisco Talos said the malware looks specifically for refusal responses before it switches models. That tells you the authors expected safety filters to stop them some of the time and wrote the code to get around it. A refused request just moves down the list. The job the models are givenAfter the stolen data arrives, VOLTA asks the model to estimate how much the victim is worth financially. The models can also point out valuable assets and rank them by how lucrative they might be. They can rate the strength of the victim's cybersecurity too. This takes the slowest work off the attacker's plate. No one has to read thousands of stolen logs to decide which victims to go after. Crypto wallets come firstTalos named VOLTA's ability to extract crypto wallet information, recovery seed phrases included, as one of its most dangerous features. With a seed phrase, an attacker could potentially get into the digital assets it protects.VOLTA can also crack cryptocurrency wallet vaults. People who store wallet credentials on their computer are exactly who this feature is meant for. The rest of your data is on the list as wellAccording to Cisco Talos security researcher Ryan Fetterman, VOLTA also takes saved browser passwords, payment card details, authentication tokens and email credentials. It hijacks active Telegram, Discord, Steam and Roblox sessions. Outlook accounts and Slack workspaces are targets too, along with any other personal or work data on the infected machine. Email gets particular focus. VOLTA can search Gmail accounts for receipts and purchase confirmations from Amazon, PayPal, Walmart, DoorDash and Uber Eats. An attacker can use those to figure out a victim's identity, home address, job and spending habits. What the profile addsA typical stealer leaves an attacker with a stack of credentials. VOLTA leaves them with the same stack and a profile of the victim, assembled from their inbox and their wallets. Anyone can sign up for every model on its list today, and OpenRouter links to all of them. The most useful step for readers is the one VOLTA punishes hardest: keep your seed phrase and wallet vault credentials off the Windows machine you use for email and gaming.

ae.title: Laboratoires Pierre Fabre announces the approval of BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib) in combination with MEKTOVI® (binimetinib) for the treatment of adult patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer with a BRAFV600E mutation in Singapore
ae.description: New targeted treatment option now available in for adult patients with BRAFV600E mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) Launch follows European approval based on results from the Phase II PHAROS trial, demonstrating meaningful clinical benefit to patients with a high objective response rate (ORR)1,2 SINGAPORE, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Laboratoires Pierre Fabre Singapore is delighted to announce the access for patients to BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib) in combination with MEKTOVI® (binimetinib) for the treatment of adult patients with advanced NSCLC with a BRAFV600E mutation. It follows the European Commission (EC) approval that was based on the results from the Phase II PHAROS trial, a global, open-label, multicentre, non-randomised trial to determine the efficacy and safety of BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® in 98 patients from 56 study centres across 5 countries.1,2 Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths, with 1,278 deaths in Singapore annually, and 1,942 new cases diagnosed every year whereby 1-2% of NSCLC are BRAFV600E mutant.3,4 "We are delighted to be able to bring BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® to NSCLC patients with a BRAFV600E mutation in Singapore. This approval from Health Sciences Authority (HSA) is a significant milestone as BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® will give patients the option of an additional effective targeted therapy. This is a further demonstration of our commitment to addressing the most critical needs in cancer care today through the delivery of clinically meaningful treatments," said Jairo Pardey, General Manager Laboratoires Pierre Fabre, Singapore. About the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) approval The BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® Singapore approved prescribing information includes results from the Phase II PHAROS trial.1,5,6 At primary analysis (cut-off date: September 22, 2022), the primary endpoint of the trial (objective response rate [ORR] determined by independent radiology review [IRR]) was met. In the treatment-naïve population (n=59), the ORR was 75% (95% CI: 62, 85), including 15% complete responses (CRs) and 59% partial responses (PRs).1,5,6 Updated results with an additional 10-month follow-up showed that 64% of patients maintained a response for at least 12 months, with a median duration of response (mDOR) per IRR of 40 months (95% CI: 23.1, not estimable [NE]). 5,6* For those patients who had received prior therapy (n=39), the ORR by IRR was 46% (95% CI: 30, 63), including 10% CRs and 36% PRs at primary analysis.1,5,6 Updated results with an additional 10-month follow-up showed that 44% of patients maintained a response for at least 12 months with a mDOR of 16.7 months (95% CI: 7.4, NE).5,6* The most common treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs ≥20%) were nausea (50%), diarrhoea (43%), fatigue (32%), and vomiting (29%). Treatment-related serious AEs occurred in 14% of patients, with the most common being colitis (3%).1,6 One grade 5 TRAE of intracranial haemorrhage was reported.1 *Results for mDOR from a sensitivity analysis considering new anti-cancer therapy as an event in addition to progression and death are 23.1 months in treatment-naïve patients (14.8, NE) and 12.0 months (6.3, NE) in previously treated patients.5 About PHAROS PHAROS (NCT03915951) is an on-going open-label, single arm, multicentre, non-randomised Phase II trial to determine the efficacy and safety of BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib 450 mg QD) in combination with MEKTOVI® (binimetinib 45 mg BID) in 98 patients with advanced NSCLC with a BRAFV600E mutation who are either treatment-naive or who have been previously treated with platinum-based chemotherapy and/or anti-PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor therapy. Mutations were identified using next-generation sequencing or polymerase chain reaction tests. The primary endpoint is confirmed ORR per RECIST v1.1, by independent radiology review (IRR); secondary objectives comprise additional efficacy endpoints including duration of response (DOR), progression-free survival, and overall survival as well as safety. The trial is being conducted across 56 sites in: Italy, the Netherlands, South Korea, Spain, and the U.S. The PHAROS trial is sponsored by Pfizer Inc. and conducted with support from Laboratoires Pierre Fabre. About BRAFV600E mutant advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths, with over 1.8 million deaths worldwide annually.7 Globally, lung cancers make up 12.4% of all cancers with over 2.4 million new cases every year.8 Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) accounts for approximately 80-85% of all lung cancers.9.10 Currently, it is estimated that up to 69% of advanced NSCLC patients have druggable mutations in numerous genes.11 BRAFV600E mutations occur in approximately 1-2% of NSCLC cases.4 It stimulates tumour cell growth and proliferation by altering the MAP kinase (MAPK) signalling pathway. Inhibition of both BRAF and the downstream mitogen activated protein kinase (MEK) pathway has been shown to improve response rates in patients compared with BRAF inhibition alone.1,12 Precision medicine has made great progress in the treatment of lung cancer for NSCLC patients with genetic alterations, such as BRAFV600E mutations, that can be detected using biomarker tests.13,14 Advances in targeted therapy and more widespread use of biomarker testing have been associated with significant improvements in population-level NSCLC mortality in recent years.15 About BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® BRAFTOVI® (encorafenib), a potent and highly selective BRAF inhibitor with a distinct pharmacological profile compared with other BRAF inhibitors, and MEKTOVI® (binimetinib), a potent and selective MEK inhibitor, inhibit kinases in the MAPK pathway – which is constitutively activated in BRAFV600E mutant NSCLC - resulting in clinically relevant anti-tumour activity. Uncontrolled activation of this pathway has been shown to occur in many cancers, including melanoma, CRC, and NSCLC.1,16 In 2018, the European Commission (EC) approved BRAFTOVI® + MEKTOVI® for adult patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAFV600 mutation. The approval was based on results from the randomised, active-controlled, open-label, multicentre Phase III COLUMBUS trial. In 2020, the EC approved BRAFTOVI® in combination with cetuximab, for the treatment of adults with metastatic CRC with a BRAFV600E mutation who have received prior systemic therapy. The approval was based on results from the randomised, active-controlled, open-label, multicentre Phase III BEACON CRC trial. Pfizer has exclusive rights to commercialise BRAFTOVI® and MEKTOVI® in the U.S., Canada, and all countries in the Latin American, African, and Middle Eastern regions; Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. has exclusive rights to commercialise both products in Japan and South Korea; Medison has exclusive rights in Israel; and Laboratoires Pierre Fabre has exclusive rights in all other countries, including Europe and Asia-Pacific. The full product and safety information for the use of BRAFTOVI® and MEKTOVI® are outlined in the Product Information (PI) published in the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) database and can be accessed here. About Laboratoires Pierre Fabre Laboratoires Pierre Fabre is one of Europe's leading pharmaceutical laboratories and the world's second-largest dermo-cosmetics company. Its Pharma activity covers 5 main therapeutic fields: oncology, dermatology, rare diseases, primary care and family health care. The Dermo-cosmetics & Personal Care portfolio includes international brands such as Eau Thermale Avène, Dexeryl, Ducray, Klorane, A-Derma, René Furterer, Même Cosmetics, Darrow and Elgydium. For over 40 years, Laboratoires Pierre Fabre has established itself as an international player in oncology, mastering the entire value chain from R&D to marketing. Its portfolio of oncology specialties covers colorectal, breast, lung and skin cancers, as well as certain hematologic malignancies and precancerous dermatological conditions such as actinic keratosis. ae.title: Beyondsoft Showcases Financial AI Solutions for Southeast Asian Markets at Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026
ae.description: Company presents financial technology platforms and shares experience in adapting solutions for Southeast Asian markets HONG KONG, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Beyondsoft showcased its financial AI and digital solutions at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026, where the company also shared its experience of adapting fintech capabilities developed in China to the needs of Southeast Asian markets. Visitors engage with Beyondsoft at its exhibition booth. The company presented its AI agent platform, mobile application development platform and enterprise digital currency payment collection system. Its team met with financial institutions, technology companies and industry organisations to discuss AI applications, implementation challenges and opportunities for collaboration across the region. AI and Digital Solutions for Financial Services Beyondsoft's AI agent platform combines large language models with industry knowledge bases to support risk management, oversight of funds, automated regulatory reporting and targeted customer engagement. The platform is designed to bring AI into financial workflows and help institutions explore end-to-end automation of core business processes. Built on Beyondsoft's proprietary technology, the mobile application development platform supports financial apps across multiple device environments and enables faster updates, helping teams improve development and delivery efficiency. The enterprise digital currency payment collection system provides payment collection services for financial institutions and corporate clients through a customised software-as-a-service model. Conversations at the exhibition focused on where financial AI agents could be most useful, how to implement them and how to assess their business value. The team also discussed potential partnerships in mobile financial services and digital payments. Adapting China's Fintech Experience to Southeast Asian Markets As part of the event, Ariel Lin, who leads Beyondsoft's Innovation Lab and AI Practice, delivered a presentation on adapting China's financial AI capabilities to Southeast Asian markets. Drawing on China's experience in core banking, AI-powered lending at scale and generative AI in production, Lin emphasised that international expansion requires more than exporting products. Technical expertise, experienced people and proven delivery practices are equally important. Customer expectations, operations and infrastructure vary across Southeast Asia. Technology providers need to adapt their solutions to each market and work with local teams to build the skills needed to maintain and develop them. Technology transfer and knowledge sharing can help local businesses build these capabilities over time. Addressing Local Regulatory Requirements The presentation also examined differences in regulatory requirements across Southeast Asia, with examples from Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. Topics included data protection, biometric identity verification, the fairness and explainability of AI-assisted decisions, and financial data sharing. For cross-border projects, these requirements need to be considered from the outset. Data use must comply with applicable purpose limitations and consent requirements. Biometric applications require attention to liveness detection and accuracy, while AI-assisted decisions need to address fairness and explainability. Financial data sharing must also comply with local banking secrecy and credit information requirements. Lin emphasised that compliance needs to be built into solution design and implementation to help financial institutions manage the risks of deploying AI across markets. Experience in Cross-Border Delivery Beyondsoft's work for the overseas branches of a Chinese global bank illustrated the demands of cross-border technology delivery. The projects covered personal and corporate mobile banking, credit card applications, mobile workplace tools and mobile learning platforms. The work required experience in financial systems development, coordination across platforms and complex project delivery. For institutions operating across borders, individual applications also need to work together, support business continuity and meet regional requirements. With its International Headquarters in Singapore, Beyondsoft continues to connect technology expertise from China with business needs in Southeast Asia. Drawing on its financial technology experience and global service network, the company will explore AI applications and service models suited to regional markets, working with industry partners to bring AI into financial business processes. ****** About Beyondsoft Beyondsoft is a global technology services and solutions company helping organisations accelerate digital transformation and turn technology into business value. With more than 30 years of experience and a global talent network of nearly 30,000 professionals, Beyondsoft delivers capabilities spanning AI and data intelligence, cloud and infrastructure, digital platforms, enterprise applications, managed services and localisation capabilities. With its International Headquarters in Singapore, Beyondsoft supports organisations across Southeast Asia and beyond, combining global technology expertise with local market delivery capabilities. Through its ecosystem of technology partners and industry solutions, Beyondsoft works with organisations of all sizes to adopt emerging technologies, improve operational efficiency and drive sustainable growth. www.beyondsoft.com

zm.title: Blackstone, Canadian pension funds to invest $3.1bn in LNG Canada for Mitsubishi stake

The holding company owns a 15% stake in LNG Canada, the Shell-led export project in British Columbia that started production in June 2025. Mitsubishi said its stake is valued at about $1.6-billion. mg.title: PATRIMOINE TOURISTIQUE - Le site du Cirque Rouge menacé d’envahissement
mg.description: La gestion et la sécurité du site du Cirque Rouge, au Grand Pavois, sont confiées à la commune rurale de Belobaka, dans le district de Mahajanga II, depuis juin 2025. La commune urbaine de Mahajanga et le Fonds Lovako, relevant du ministère de la Culture et de la Communication, en assurent, quant à eux, la cogestion. Les retombées obtenues seront partagées. Depuis l’an 2000, de nombreux visiteurs s’intéressent au site, qui est aujourd’hui l’un des lieux touristiques incontournables de la région Boeny. La construction de maisons à l’intérieur et aux abords du site constitue une grave menace pour sa conservation. Vendredi, les représentants de la direction régionale de la Culture et de la Communication (DIRCC) Boeny, de la direction régionale de l’Aménagement du territoire (DRTA) Boeny, des antennes Lovako Boeny, de l’Office régional du tourisme de Boeny (ORTB), de la région Boeny ainsi que de la commune rurale de Belobaka ont effectué une visite du site touristique et naturel du Cirque Rouge. Ce patrimoine national protégé est menacé par des occupations de terrain et des risques d’accaparement foncier. L’utilisation des terrains situés autour du Cirque Rouge soulève également des difficultés. Des projets de construction de routes sont en cours et des boutiques d’artisanat malgache sont installées à l’intérieur du site. En raison de l’absence d’accès à son terrain situé à l’arrière du cirque, un particulier a demandé l’ouverture d’une route traversant le site touristique. Il a déclaré avoir déposé une demande, mais n’avoir encore reçu aucune réponse. Par ailleurs, une autre route a été ouverte et traverse l’aire de stationnement réservée aux visiteurs, à l’intérieur du site. Selon Tantely Lasy Gasy, qui déclare être propriétaire du terrain, cette route se trouve sur sa propriété privée. Il a installé un panneau interdisant le stationnement sur place. La résolution de ce différend apparaît dès lors urgente. Une délimitation claire du périmètre du site est nécessaire pour protéger le patrimoine et prévenir sa dégradation. « Cette situation nécessite un examen et une coordination avec les autorités compétentes. Le ministère de la Communication et de la Culture n’est pas informé de ce projet de construction de route dans la zone du Cirque Rouge. Il est urgent et indispensable de procéder à la délimitation juridique et géographique de la zone du musée du Cirque Rouge », a déclaré le directeur régional de la Culture et de la Communication de Boeny, Tantely Fanja Rabenasolo. Vero Andrianarisoa

mg.title: JIRAMA - La nouvelle station de Mandroseza raccordée au réseau
mg.description: Le raccordement de la nouvelle station de traitement d’eau de Mandroseza aux infrastructures existantes de la Jirama a été achevé ce lundi 2 novembre. Cette opération concerne une grande partie de l’agglomération d’Antananarivo, où le retour de l’approvisionnement en eau reste attendu après plusieurs travaux sur les installations. La connexion entre la nouvelle station et le réseau de distribution est désormais réalisée. Toutefois, la reprise de l’approvisionnement ne sera pas immédiate. Selon la Jirama, l’ampleur des interventions effectuées nécessite encore du temps avant le retour de l’eau dans les canalisations qui alimentent les différents quartiers. Les perturbations concernent aussi bien le centre-ville que les secteurs périphériques. Plusieurs quartiers de la capitale, notamment Ambohijatovo, Faravohitra, Antaninarenina, Behoririka, Andravoahangy, Manjakaray et Anjanahary, figurent parmi les zones desservies par ce réseau. D’autres secteurs, dont Mahamasina, Ambanidia, Ambohipo et la Haute Ville, sont également concernés. L’approvisionnement s’étend par ailleurs à plusieurs communes environnantes, notamment Alasora, Tanjombato, Andoharanofotsy et Ankaraobato. Une partie des localités situées aux alentours dépend également de ces installations. La fin du raccordement marque une étape dans les travaux réalisés à Mandroseza. Reste maintenant le retour effectif de l’eau dans les foyers. Pour les habitants concernés, le délai annoncé avant la reprise de la distribution demeure un élément important, alors que l’approvisionnement régulier reste indispensable aux besoins quotidiens des ménages. Fanilo Mampianintsoa

mg.title: TRAITEMENT - Babaïque en voie de guérison
mg.description: En soins en Inde depuis septembre, Babaïque voit son état de santé s’améliorer. Son retour à Madagascar est envisagé fin novembre, selon FalyBicky, membre de son groupe. Les nouvelles sont encourageantes pour Babaïque. Après plusieurs semaines de prise en charge médicale en Inde, l’artiste retrouve progressivement des forces. Son état s’améliore et il peut désormais se déplacer, même si son traitement se poursuit sous surveillance médicale. « Il va beaucoup mieux maintenant et peut désormais se déplacer », indique FalyBicky, membre de son groupe, qui reste en contact avec le chanteur. Son retour au pays pourrait être envisagé vers la fin du mois de novembre, sans qu’une date précise soit encore confirmée. La prise en charge porte toujours sur son insuffisance cardiaque. L’équipe médicale s’attache actuellement à stabiliser son état avant d’envisager la suite des soins. « Il poursuit encore son traitement. Les médecins cherchent avant tout à stabiliser son état, notamment en ce qui concerne son insuffisance cardiaque », précise FalyBicky. Pour le moment, aucune activité artistique n’est programmée pour le chanteur, qui doit avant tout se consacrer à son rétablissement. Mobilisation Arrivé en Inde le 3 septembre, Babaïque, âgé de 55 ans, était malade depuis environ 1 an. Il avait auparavant suivi plusieurs mois de chimiothérapie, avant que son état ne se complique avec l’apparition d’une insuffisance cardiaque. Pris en charge à l’hôpital de Befelatanana, il a ensuite été évacué sanitairement pour poursuivre ses soins et bénéficier d’un suivi médical approfondi. Cette évacuation a nécessité une importante mobilisation. Elle a notamment été rendue possible grâce à Mamy Gotso, aux ministères de l’Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche scientifique et de la Communication et de la Culture, à l’association Manavao et Fanjiry, à Fidelis Manager, ainsi qu’à des artistes, des proches et différentes associations. Sa famille, confrontée à d’importantes dépenses médicales, avait également lancé un appel à la solidarité. Elle adresse ses remerciements à tous ceux qui ont apporté un soutien financier ou moral et continuent de prier pour son rétablissement. De son vrai nom David Baba Jean David, Babaïque est né le 26 février 1971. Il s’est imposé sur la scène musicale malgache au début des années 2000. Auteur-compositeur évoluant principalement dans la variété et le salegy, il s’est notamment fait connaître grâce au titre « Anao Tiako », interprété en duo avec Cynthia. Il est également l’auteur de « Ilaiko anao », chanté par Bodo, et de « Mbo Ho Janga », interprété par Lianah. Sa dernière apparition sur scène remonte au 1er mai, à Mahamasina, à l’occasion d’un spectacle organisé par l’association des natifs de la région d’Antsiranana. Dans l’attente de son retour, le chanteur doit désormais poursuivre ses soins jusqu’à la stabilisation de son état de santé. Cassie Ramiandrasoa

mg.title: ANTANANARIVO Le VIH et le Sida emportent trois à cinq jeunes chaque semaine
mg.description: Entre trois et cinq jeunes âgés de 19 à 25 ans, porteurs du VIH, décèdent chaque semaine des suites du sida dans un grand centre hospitalier d’Antananarivo, selon les données du Programme national de lutte contre les infections sexuellement transmissibles et le VIH/sida (PNLIS). Un chiffre qui rappelle que l’infection continue de faire des victimes parmi les jeunes et que les efforts de prévention et de prise en charge restent nécessaires. Cette situation intervient dans un contexte où les acteurs de la lutte contre le VIH cherchent à renforcer leurs interventions. Le 27 octobre, une rencontre réunissant les partenaires et les différents intervenants s’est tenue au Radisson Blu, à Ambodivona, à l’initiative du ministère de la Santé publique, à travers le PNLIS. Les discussions ont notamment porté sur les résultats de l’enquête nationale de séroprévalence. Dépistage précoce Ces données doivent permettre de mieux cerner la situation épidémiologique du pays et d’orienter les prochaines actions. L’accès au dépistage, la prévention et le maintien des personnes vivant avec le VIH dans le parcours de soins figurent parmi les principaux défis évoqués. Pour les jeunes, l’enjeu reste particulièrement important. Les décès rapportés dans cet établissement hospitalier soulèvent la question du dépistage précoce et de l’accès aux traitements. Une infection détectée tardivement peut entraîner des complications graves, alors qu’une prise en charge adaptée permet aux personnes vivant avec le VIH de suivre un traitement et de préserver leur santé. La coordination entre les institutions publiques, les partenaires techniques et financiers, les organisations de la société civile et les communautés a également été au cœur des échanges. Le renforcement de cette collaboration doit contribuer à mieux répartir les responsabilités et à mobiliser les ressources nécessaires. Les chiffres communiqués par le PNLIS donnent ainsi une dimension concrète aux défis de la lutte contre le VIH à Madagascar, particulièrement auprès des jeunes. Fanilo Mampianintsoa

mg.title: TANJOMBATO - Une friteuse à l’origine d’un incendie
mg.description: Un bâtiment servant à la fois d’habitation et de commerce a pris feu à Malaza, dans la commune rurale de Tanjombato, district d’Antananarivo Atsimondrano, le 1er novembre 2026, vers 18 h 45. Selon une source auprès des forces de l’ordre, l’alerte a été donnée par des riverains. Ces derniers ont indiqué avoir tenté de joindre les sapeurs-pompiers, sans obtenir de réponse. Une unité spéciale de la Police nationale de Tanjombato s’est immédiatement rendue sur place pour participer à l’extinction du feu et sécuriser les alentours afin d’empêcher la propagation des flammes. Grâce à cette intervention rapide, le feu a été maîtrisé en peu de temps et les dégâts sont restés limités. Une friteuse ainsi que des marchandises destinées à la vente ont notamment été endommagées. Selon les explications du propriétaire des lieux, le feu est parti de la friteuse. Aucun blessé ni décès n’a été déploré. La situation était entièrement revenue à la normale après l’intervention des forces de l’ordre. Miora Aristodème

mg.title: CINÉMA ET THÉÂTRE - Cinq disciplines artistiques au cœur de formations à Anosy
mg.description: L’ISSM, l’ANAC et Creare Training Center proposent trois jours de formations gratuites en cinéma et arts de la scène. Le cinéma et les arts de la scène seront à l’honneur du 10 au 12 novembre 2026 à Antananarivo. À travers une initiative dédiée au renforcement des compétences artistiques, l’ISSM et l’Académie nationale des arts et de la culture (ANAC), en partenariat avec Creare Training Center, organisent trois jours de formations gratuites à la bibliothèque d’Anosy, dans la salle Dox. Cinq disciplines seront explorées : l’écriture de scénarios, le jeu d’acteur, le clown, le mime et le théâtre. Les inscriptions se dérouleront du 2 au 5 novembre. Les participants pourront découvrir différentes approches de ces pratiques et approfondir leurs connaissances auprès de deux intervenants, Jolene du Plessis et Cornelis Van Heyningen. Les séances se tiendront de 9 h à 12 h, puis de 14 h à 16 h, durant les trois journées. Ouvertes aux acteurs inscrits dans le registre, aux étudiants, aux débutants, aux professionnels ainsi qu’à toute personne intéressée par ces disciplines, ces formations visent à élargir l’accès à l’apprentissage artistique. Les organisateurs souhaitent notamment consolider les compétences techniques et créatives des participants, tout en favorisant la découverte et l’émergence de nouveaux talents dans le paysage culturel malgache. Cassie Ramiandrasoa
